guidance.heading: GUIDANCE
section: For the full year 2026, we are raising our gross profit growth expectations to be between 12.5% to 14.0% and expect gross margin to be approximately 21.5%. We now expect our Adjusted diluted earnings per share to be between $13.55 and $13.75. This represents approximately 27% growth at the midpoint of $13.65 compared to our full year 2025 Adjusted diluted earnings per share of $10.75.
